title: pretty AMOUR|Stylish Plus Size Chiffon Formal Evening Dresses with Long Lantern Sleeves
descriptionHtml:
It is time to look like a princess by wearing this gorgeous plus size chiffon long lantern sleeves evening dress for curve. This plus lantern sleeves curvy formal dress features deep V-neck and long bishop sleeves. There is also applique designing near waistline which helps to accentuate the waist. This plus size maxi evening dress with lantern sleeves is solely made for plus size women so they can feel beautiful. We think this gorgeous plus long sleeve formal dress is perfect for all formal occasions, from evening party, cocktail, weddings to prom, homecoming, and graduation!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.

Length: Floor length.

Sleeve Style: Long sleeves.

Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.

Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.

Fabric: The garment comprises chiffon.

Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
